About the role

We’re looking for a talented Data Privacy Compliance Manager/Counsel with a passion for critical thinking and problem solving to join our Global Privacy team. Reporting to the Americas Data Privacy Officer, you will assist with driving key data protection initiatives across Convatec’s global business. In doing so, you’ll join a talented and supportive Privacy Team and work closely with key stakeholders across the business, promoting a strong culture of handling and managing personal data sensitively and effectively.

With an increasing focus on adopting and developing AI, this role is also uniquely positioned to help build and shape Convatec’s Responsible AI Programme.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support our Americas Data Privacy Officer to deliver the Privacy Team’s global strategy in Americas, by being the primary point of contact for the LATAM businesses and by monitoring legal and regulatory developments across the region, and advising on necessary adaptions and improvements to Convatec’s Privacy Programme.

  • Serve as a Privacy expert for our Americas businesses and working closely with and advising businesses and clinical leaders, counsel, and other colleagues on all aspects of privacy, including performing Data Protection Impact Assessments, reviewing Data Protection Agreements/clauses, supporting supplier due diligence, marketing initiatives, embedding privacy by design into projects including IT projects, digital initiatives, responding to data subjects’ rights requests and data breaches.

  • Support the Americas Data Privacy Officer in maturing the regional Privacy Programme to develop, refine and simplify scalable, policies, processes, and systems to protect the patient, Health Care Professional, and employee data we process whilst enabling the business to fulfil its mission of creating pioneering heathcare.

  • Work with the wider Legal team to develop and strengthen precedents, playbooks and processes to streamline and supercharge the team.

  • Work collaboratively with key stakeholders, including LATAM Leadership teams and country managers, the Digital Solutions, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, HR and Information Security teams, advising on new projects, setting clear accountabilities and policies for data protection.

  • Develop and deliver engaging and helpful training and awareness programmes.

  • Monitor privacy and AI regulation and advise on required/desired adaptations and improvements to Convatec’s Privacy and Responsible AI Programmes.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Previous experience within a compliance, legal, audit, or risk function required with a solid focus in data protection matters.

  • Demonstrable experience of leading on a range of privacy projects and issues

  • Strong commercial acumen: able to take a pragmatic approach to legal risk and advise the business accordingly.

  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across all levels of the business

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Strong team player, self-starter, and can-do approach; no job is too big or too small.

  • Interest in technology and AI

Desirable:

  • Prior in-house experience within healthcare

  • Prior experience advising on AI matters including emerging AI laws and building AI governance programmes.

  • Familiarity with data protection regimes (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, PIPL, etc.)

  • Experience with data risk management and/or supporting audits from a privacy perspective.

Qualifications/Education:

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree

  • Qualified to practice law (in Brazil and Colombia) or equivalent jurisdiction OR CIPP or equivalent data protection qualification and industry experience.

  • Experience with Healthcare market.

  • Fluent English level.

  • Fliuent Spanish level.

What you’ll get:

• Hybrid role based in the UK

• Competitive salary + bonus

• Training & development

• Collaborative, supportive culture

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges -- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes -- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do:

The Product Owner is responsible for ensuring that market and product requirements are appropriately reflected and implemented in a finished product. Largely an inward-facing role, the product owner is the main liaison between product marketing, product management and the engineering team. The product owner is an expert on the functionality of a specific product; as such, s/he often supports other groups such as sales engineering, implementation, and technical support/customer service.

More specifically, you will:

  • Act as the primary liaison between product management and engineering teams, translating product strategy into actionable requirements
  • Lead the product backlog management process, prioritizing features that maximize business value aligned with product roadmap
  • Create and maintain product requirements documentation, functional specifications, and user stories
  • Oversee product development lifecycle from conception through testing and release
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, alpha/beta programs, and manage bug fixes and product improvements
  • Collaborate across multiple departments including UX/Product Design, Regulatory Analysis, Customer Support, Professional Services, and Product Marketing
  • Communicate effectively with all stakeholders throughout the development process, providing regular updates on progress and changes

What We Need From You

  • 4+ years experience in product management, business analysis, or related field, preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Strong understanding of the Agile methodology and demonstrated success in the Product Owner role
  • Ability to balance analytical thinking with intuitive decision-making, and willingness to make difficult decisions when necessary
  • Experience mentoring teams and effectively prioritizing work to maximize business outcomes
  • Advanced English communication skills; both written and verbal
  • Engage stakeholders effectively, communicating the 'why, how, and when' of product decisions
  • Optimize priorities and scope to deliver maximum value
  • Comprehend and communicate complex concepts
  • Analyze and resolve complex problems while maintaining a strategic perspective

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

  • Flexible Time-Off
  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs
  • Virtual English Club through Rosetta Stone, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter .

Descrição da empresa

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft acquired Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of Spanish company Elecnor, including nine operational wind farms in Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. This made the company one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing 2.2 GW of installed capacity through acquisitions, constructions, and operations.

The company pioneers in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying the energy's origin via I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), ensuring sustainable operations.

  • Postgraduate degree in Engineering or Economics;
  • Solid experience in Brazil's electricity sector;
  • Experience in portfolio management;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R/Python coding;
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

title: Support Manager Customer Care · São José dos Campos ·
description:
About edrone

We’re a fast-growing startup that’s transforming the way e-commerce businesses connect with their customers. We develop an all-in-one platform designed to help online stores grow through automation, AI and data-driven insights.

We are ambitious, always aiming higher. We move at high speed, embracing constant change and new challenges every day. Transparency is one of our core values: we communicate openly, share feedback and make bold decisions with courage.

If you’re looking for a dynamic and challenging environment where you’ll learn fast and help shape the future of e-commerce, edrone is the right place for you!

About the role:

Support Manager (Brazil) is a key leadership role created as part of edrone’s strategy to grow our presence and revenue in the Brazilian market. This person will lead our Customer Care department, which includes three crucial areas: Customer Success, Onboarding, and Customer Service — with a strong focus on turning these teams into growth engines.

You won’t just manage processes and people — you’ll drive revenue. Your mission is to retain, grow and unlock value from our customer base by improving onboarding speed, increasing feature adoption, boosting satisfaction, and maximizing expansion opportunities. You'll collaborate closely with local leadership and global stakeholders to align customer care strategy with revenue goals.

What your typical day will look like:

  • Manage and develop a team of 3 team leaders across Onboarding, Customer Success, and Customer Service
  • Foster a high-performance culture based on accountability, ownership, and results
  • Ensure collaboration across the three areas and alignment with company strategy
  • Attract, hire, and train top talents for key positions as the team grows
  • Build, track, and improve KPIs across the Customer Care teams
  • Work closely with other departments (Product, Sales, Marketing, and Tech) to improve the customer journey and value delivery
  • Collaborate effectively with the Polish team to ensure alignment, share best practices, and drive unified customer care strategies across markets
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in current processes and lead initiatives to optimize efficiency and experience
  • Own and evolve the Customer Journey Framework to increase customer satisfaction and lifetime value
  • Be a key player in MRR growth through improved retention, upselling, and onboarding speed
  • Represent the Support area in internal leadership meetings, ensuring your department's voice is heard in broader decisions
  • Build a knowledge-sharing environment between Customer Care and other teams to ensure everyone is aligned around customer needs and business impact

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary support or Customer Care teams (preferably in SaaS or eCommerce)
  • Solid track record of delivering customer satisfaction while driving business KPIs (churn, upsell, MRR)
  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on approach
  • Strong leadership and coaching skills – you know how to build a team, not just manage one
  • Ability to manage complexity, prioritize effectively, and stay focused in fast-changing environments
  • Ability to communicate with assertiveness and enjoy challenging debates with C-Levels
  • Capability to perform in a challenging environment with high-pressure and high-speed
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian market
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English

What we offer:

  • A comprehensive onboarding process to set you up for success
  • A strategic, high-impact position — you’ll shape the direction of Customer Care in one of edrone’s key markets

Benefits:

  • Food voucher
  • Transportation voucher and home office assistance
  • TotalPass for you and your family
  • Health and dental insurance
  • English lessons paid by edrone
  • Full SESC credential
  • Life insurance
  • Telavita for mental health support
  • Hybrid from São José dos Campos/SP

What the recruitment process looks like:

  1. A 30-minute online chat with People and Culture Partner – Giovanna Dias , where we’ll get to know you better
  2. A 45-minute online conversation with Chief of Customer Care – Wioleta Jednaka-Gracz , focused on your skills and experience
  3. Final interview with key managers
  4. Welcome aboard!

Regardless of the outcome at any stage, you will always receive feedback from us regarding your application.

Ele também é responsável por assegurar que a arquitetura dos sistemas esteja alinhada com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, além de promover inovação tecnológica.

title: Job Page | MÉDICO CLINICO GERAL
description:
Garantir a prestação qualitativa dos serviços de assistência e de preservação da saúde, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

Executar procedimentos clínicos, atendendo dúvidas, dificuldades dos pacientes, orientando e indicando tratamentos.

Exposição habitual e permanente ao risco biológico (Vírus e Bactérias).

Realizar consultas, exames clínicos, solicitar exames e acompanhar o tratamento clínico, visando o reestabelecimento do paciente, respeitando e colaborando no aperfeiçoamento de normas e procedimentos operacionais.

Prescrever tratamento, encaminhar para serviços especializados.

Participar da elaboração, execução e avaliação de programas, da normatização de procedimentos relativos a sua área de abrangência.

Desenvolver ações e atividades educativas junto aos pacientes, empregados e comunidade.

Conhecer e atualizar os recursos médicos disponíveis, normas e rotinas de serviço.

Organizar, manter e controlar os equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais sob sua guarda e utilização, requisitando sua manutenção preventiva e corretiva.

Emitir relatórios de suas ações e atividades.

Responsabilizar-se pelas informações constantes no prontuário, na receita, no atestado e na guia de encaminhamento subscrita.

Participar de reuniões, treinamentos e desenvolvimentos para aperfeiçoamento do processo de trabalho.

Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho.

Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato.

Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolvam a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes.

Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.

Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina, Residência completa e/ou título de especialista e Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE).

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento na área da assistência social e na área educacional. Essa gama de atividades consolida a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para isso, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 no município de São Paulo, estendendo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde então, busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Periodicamente, publica anúncios recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e municípios onde se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população, de forma ética e humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Global Procurement Specialist
description:
Sao Paulo, São Paulo, BR

Com 11.000 pessoas em 35 países, a COFCO International é a plataforma de negócios agricolas no exterior da COFCO Corporation, a maior empresa de alimentos e agricultura da China. A COFCO International está focada em ser lider mundial em grãos, oleaginosas e cadeias de fornecimento de açúcar, com ativos nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico. A Empresa comercializa com mais de 50 países proporcionando aos agricultores um acesso direto, único ao crescente mercado chinês. Em 2017, a COFCO International movimentou mais de 100 Milhões de Toneladas de commodities, com receita de 34 Bilhões de USD. A Empresa está acelerando seu crescimento para criar uma cadeia global de fornecimento agrícola integrada, ancorada na demanda da China e competindo globalmente. .

O Especialista em Suprimentos desempenha um papel fundamental na área de automação de processos, atuando como o principal elo entre as partes interessadas do negócio, equipes de excelência operacional e times técnicos, garantindo que as oportunidades adequadas sejam identificadas e desenvolvidas de acordo com a estratégia e os processos de automação da empresa, gerando valor de negócio significativo e mensurável.

Principais Atividades

  • Liderar projetos de transformação digital e automação de processos de procurement (ex.: SAP, COUPA).
  • Implementar e sustentar a Política Global de Compras e os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão.
  • Atuar como SME (Subject Matter Expert) em processos e compliance de Procurement Global.
  • Coordenar iniciativas de limpeza, governança e migração de dados mestres (materiais e serviços).
  • Realizar mapeamento de processos ('as-is') e propor melhorias com foco em eficiência e redução de desperdícios.
  • Traduzir processos em diagramas funcionais claros e viáveis (BPMN ou similar).
  • Coletar requisitos de negócios, definindo soluções escaláveis com times técnicos e de arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver planos de testes e gerenciar mudanças e treinamentos antes de implementações.
  • Administrar o Service Now Procurement, incluindo o design e a implementação de configurações para otimizar os fluxos de trabalho de procurement.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos de processos para compradores e equipes de negócios, focando na Política Global de Global Procurement (em conjunto com L&D), Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SoPs) e Lições de Um Ponto (One-Point Lessons).

Requisitos

• Graduação em Engenharia, Administração ou Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
• Pós-graduação ou certificações em Procurement, Supply Chain, Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, CSM) ou Engenharia de Dados são diferenciais.

• Inglês Avançado/fluente (obrigatório);

• Espanhol será considerado um diferencial;

• Domínio em ferramentas de automação (RPA, BPM), Office, Visio e análise de dados;

• Conhecimentos em ferramentas de compras (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, COUPA, ARIBA);

• Vivência em gestão de dados mestres, arvores de categorias, desenho de processos e melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma).

A COFCO International oferece iguais oportunidades de trabalho, sendo que todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados sem discriminação pela raça, cor, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, deficiência, condição de veterano ou outra característica protegida pela lei.

About the team/role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Tax Planning Manager to join our tax team and lead strategic tax planning initiatives across our operations. This role is ideal for a dynamic tax professional with deep expertise in domestic and international tax planning, business partnering, and digital business models.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Product, Ops etc.) to proactively manage tax risk, identify optimization opportunities, and support business growth in a rapidly evolving regulatory and digital environment.

In this role, you'll be...

Responsible for:

Design, evaluate, and implement global and local tax strategies that align with business objectives, including expansion, restructurings, M&A, and new product launches.

Act strategically with the various business areas in the implementation of Tax Reform.

Lead planning and structuring for intercompany transactions, intellectual property, financing arrangements, and digital services across multiple jurisdictions.

Act as a strategic advisor to business leaders, proactively advising on the tax implications of multiples initiatives.

Monitor global tax developments (e.g., Tax Reform, TP, Pillar One & Two, OECD/GloBE, DSTs) and evaluate impact on the company; lead readiness and scenario planning.

• Tax Governance & Risk Management:

Develop and maintain robust tax governance frameworks. Identify and manage tax risks in compliance with global tax policies and regulatory requirements.

Support or lead tax audit defense and controversy resolution related to complex transactions.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, or related field (required). Master’s in Taxation, JD/LLM, or equivalent (preferred).

• CPA, CA, or equivalent professional certification strongly preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive tax experience, including significant exposure to tax planning for complex multinational groups.

• Strong preference for Big 4 combined with in-house experience at a TMT (preferred).

• Expertise in tax planning, consulting/business support, transfer pricing and corporate restructuring.

• Deep understanding of tax challenges facing platform business models (preferred).

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects, communicate with senior executives, and influence decision-making.

• Strong analytical, project management, and communication skills.

• Fluent in English.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven
We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães.   • Desenvolver e Implementar: Criar wireframes, protótipos e fluxos interativos que comuniquem claramente a experiência do produto e possam ser facilmente implementados pela equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Definir Padrões de Design: Estabelecer e manter diretrizes de design consistentes e práticas recomendadas para assegurar uma identidade visual coesa e de alta qualidade em todos os nossos produtos.

Representante Pós-Vendas e Suporte Técnico

A atividade de Suporte Técnico está inserida na Organização Comercial de Caminhões no Brasil. Tem como papel fundamental garantir a confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos caminhões Volvo através do trabalho conjunto com os concessionários, frente aos clientes.

A pessoa que ocupará a posição de Representante de Suporte Técnico será porta-voz dos clientes e concessionários junto à fábrica, trabalhando na melhoria contínua do produto e também promovendo soluções de produto e serviços para os clientes.

As atividades são bastante dinâmicas, sendo necessária rápida adaptação ao contexto e tomada de decisão, senso de urgência, trabalho em equipe e foco em resultado/sucesso dos clientes.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Representar a Volvo como principal interlocutor(a) de soluções técnicas de produto e auxiliar na operação/manutenção dos caminhões;
  • Atuar como voz ativa dentro da fábrica para alterações/adequações do produto buscando o desenvolvimento da melhor solução conforme necessidades do cliente;
  • Promover soluções para os problemas técnicos do produto em campo;
  • Suportar tecnicamente os concessionários (diagnósticos, métodos de reparo, ações de contenção, entre outros), assegurando a qualidade do serviço executado;
  • Monitorar não conformidades de produto e informar desvios às áreas responsáveis;
  • Conduzir negociações para remediação de problemas de produto e/ou serviço junto a concessionários e clientes;
  • Administrar o orçamento comercial e técnico conforme a região de atuação no Brasil;
  • Gestão, através de análise de dados, da performance da frota de clientes (disponibilidade, condução e consumo);
  • Assegurar a realização de campanhas de segurança;
  • Visitar (presencial e/ou virtualmente) os clientes, mantendo um relacionamento próximo e buscando qualidade, disponibilidade e satisfação constantes;
  • Auxiliar o desenvolvimento dos concessionários com foco na Satisfação dos Clientes;

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento técnico prévio na área de pós-venda (processo, reporte de problemas e tomada de decisão);
  • Conhecimento técnico na área de caminhões será um diferencial (produto e aplicações);
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Desejável Habilitação D/E;
  • Desejável espanhol básico;
  • Habilidade de negociação;
  • Fácil adaptação a mudanças;
  • Orientação a clientes e resultados;
  • Atitude para ação e resolução de problemas;
  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica ou Eletrônica.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.
This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.
We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.
This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.
Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.
Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.
Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing
Leadership and accountability
This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.
As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

A Volkswagen está na vida, no coração e na garagem dos brasileiros. São 70 anos de uma história construída por milhares de mãos, que buscam entregar produtos e serviços cada vez mais inovadores e que vão transformar os rumos da mobilidade urbana.

Esperamos oferecer experiências incríveis e construir o futuro de uma maneira mais sustentável e surpreendente.

Construa com a gente a Nossa Volkswagen !

Volkswagen tem compromisso com agenda ESG

Em 2020, a Volkswagen do Brasil aderiu aos Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres (Womens’s Empowerment Principles - WEPs, na sigla em inglês), iniciativa criada pela ONU Mulheres e o Pacto Global das Nações Unidas. Dessa forma, a VW se une a mais de 300 empresas signatárias no Brasil.

Em 2022, a Volkswagen anunciou a emissão de títulos de dívida de 500 milhões de reais, atrelados a compromissos claros da montadora de aumentar a participação de mulheres na liderança e a redução nas emissões de CO2 de origem fóssil em suas fábricas.

Com essas medidas, a VW firma ainda mais o seu compromisso em promover a igualdade de gênero na companhia, e em neutralizar emissões de carbono.

title: Preparação da cadeia produtiva de grãos exige eficiência, segurança e confiabilidade
description:
Preparação da cadeia produtiva de grãos exige eficiência, segurança e confiabilidade.

Com projeções de safra recorde 2024/25, a Loc Solution intensifica ações de atualização dos equipamentos medidores de umidade.

Por: Redação

No último mês, a empresa realizou melhorias em diversos aparelhos de três IPEMs.

As primeiras projeções da Companhia Nacional de Abastecimento (Conab) para a safra de grãos na temporada 2024/2025 apontam 322,47 milhões de toneladas, o que representa um aumento de 8,3% em relação à safra anterior. Se confirmada, esta será a maior safra registrada pela Conab, reforçando o papel estratégico do Brasil na produção mundial de grãos.

Com esse cenário, a preparação da cadeia produtiva se torna fundamental para garantir eficiência, segurança e confiabilidade no processo de comercialização de grãos.

Em resposta a essa demanda, a Loc Solution, responsável pela marca Motomco de medidores de umidade, intensificou suas ações de atualização dos equipamentos. No último mês, melhorias foram realizadas em aparelhos utilizados nos laboratórios de Metrologia da Agência Estadual de Metrologia de Mato Grosso do Sul, da Superintendência do Instituto Nacional de Metrologia e Qualidade de Goiás, e do Instituto de Metrologia e Qualidade de Minas Gerais.

"Essas atualizações reforçam a precisão e confiabilidade dos dados sobre a umidade dos grãos, essenciais para garantir transparência nas transações comerciais do setor agrícola", afirma Roney Smolareck, engenheiro agrônomo da Loc Solution.

Luiz Marcelo Scalioni, diretor do Instituto de Metrologia e Qualidade de Minas Gerais, destaca que a manutenção dos medidores de umidade é crucial para garantir que os equipamentos atendam aos padrões legais. "A manutenção regular é essencial para que os medidores operem dentro dos erros máximos admissíveis, aumentando a precisão das medições", explica Scalioni.

Luciana Boni Cogo, diretora Técnica da Agência Estadual de Metrologia de MS, acrescenta que a precisão dos medidores atualizados evita distorções nos resultados e prejuízos para produtores e compradores. "A manutenção regular contribui para uma operação de compra e venda transparente, garantindo que o equipamento esteja dentro dos parâmetros normativos. Um erro de 1% pode causar perdas significativas em transações de grande escala", comenta Luciana.

Bruno Gregório Menita, pesquisador em Metrologia e Qualidade do INMETRO, reforça que a atualização das curvas de umidade é fundamental. "A precisão nas medições assegura conformidade com a legislação do INMETRO, impactando positivamente as transações comerciais e evitando reprovações em verificações", afirma Menita.

As atualizações incluem substituição de aparelhos por modelos mais modernos, instalação de novos componentes e atualização de softwares.

A conformidade com a Portaria nº 47, de fevereiro de 2022, é central nesse processo. A medição de umidade deve ser precisa, pois afeta a qualidade do produto durante colheita, transporte e armazenamento. Controlar a umidade também influencia no valor dos grãos, facilitando transbordo, comercialização e definição de preços, explica Roney Smolareck. Ele acrescenta que os medidores Motomco atendem diversas culturas, como soja, milho, trigo e feijão.

Loc Solution/Motomco - A Loc Solution, sediada em Curitiba, é detentora da marca Motomco de medidores de umidade de grãos. Fabricante, comercializadora e locadora, é referência em várias regiões agrícolas do Brasil. De origem canadense, a Motomco lidera o segmento nacional de medidores de umidade. Mais informações em motomco.com.br .

description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

The Safety Operations Manager will lead efforts to ensure the safety and security of our users, drivers, and operations. This individual will develop and implement safety protocols, respond to emergencies, and manage crises effectively to minimize risk and impact. This role requires strategic thinking, swift decision-making, and a collaborative approach to maintaining a safe and resilient environment.

In this role, you'll be...

Lead the response to critical incidents, emergencies, or crises, ensuring rapid and effective resolution.

Monitor and analyze safety performance metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement. Monitor and evaluate vendor performance to ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards.

Serve as the primary point of contact for vendor relationships, fostering open communication and trust.

Develop, implement, and continuously improve safety policies, procedures, and protocols.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure safety is integrated into all aspects of the business.

Execute a global crisis management framework, including contingency plans and communication protocols.

Act as the primary point of contact during crises, coordinating with internal teams, law enforcement, and external stakeholders.

Provide timely and transparent communication to relevant parties during and after crises.

Oversee the reporting, documentation, and investigation of safety incidents and near-misses.

Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure adherence to local laws and regulations.

Promote a culture of safety awareness and accountability within the organization.

Organize regular drills and simulations to test and refine crisis response plans.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

5+ years of experience in safety operations, crisis management, or a related role, preferably in the mobility, transportation, or technology sector.

Strong knowledge of safety standards, risk assessment methodologies, and crisis management best practices.

Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and analytical skills.

Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead under pressure.

Proficiency in using incident management and safety monitoring tools.

Flexibility to work outside regular hours and travel as needed.

Proficiency in English, Spanish is a Plus (Not required).

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value
We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven
We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

What we are looking for

We are seeking a dynamic individual who combines technical acumen with exceptional interpersonal skills to deliver unparalleled service to our top-tier clients.

Your Skills & Experience:

  • 3+ years in Technical Support or Technical Account Management roles (Tier 2 experience preferred) or
  • 3+ years of experience working with Graphisoft products in an architectural studio, as a BIM Coordinator or BIM Manager.

At Graphisoft, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Here is what you can look forward to:

  • Opportunities for professional growth through training, mentorship, and career development programs.
  • A supportive team culture that celebrates diversity, creativity, and collaboration.

Este profissional terá um papel fundamental na identificação de inconsistências, otimização de processos e garantia da conformidade com as normas das operadoras de saúde e regulamentações do setor.

Principais Responsabilidades
Auditoria de Contas Médicas

Realizar a análise detalhada das contas médicas antes do faturamento.
Verificar a conformidade dos procedimentos realizados com os autorizados pelas operadoras.
Identificar e corrigir inconsistências nos registros médicos e de faturamento.
Análise de Documentação

Examinar prontuários, prescrições médicas e demais documentos clínicos.
Verificar a adequação e completude da documentação de suporte para cada procedimento.
Garantir que todos os serviços prestados estejam devidamente documentados e justificados.
Gestão de Glosas

Analisar as glosas recebidas das operadoras de saúde.
Preparar recursos técnicos para contestação de glosas injustificadas.
Desenvolver estratégias para redução de glosas futuras.
Conformidade e Padrões de Qualidade

Assegurar que os serviços prestados estejam em conformidade com os protocolos clínicos e diretrizes terapêuticas.
Verificar a adequação dos códigos de procedimentos utilizados.
Garantir o cumprimento das normas e regulamentações do setor de saúde suplementar.
Otimização de Processos

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de registro e faturamento.
Propor e implementar medidas para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir erros.
Colaborar com as equipes clínicas e administrativas para aprimorar os fluxos de trabalho.
Relacionamento com Operadoras

Atuar como intermediário técnico em discussões com as operadoras de saúde.
Participar de reuniões para esclarecimento de dúvidas e negociação de casos complexos.
Manter-se atualizado sobre as políticas e exigências das diferentes operadoras.
Treinamento e Orientação

Conduzir treinamentos para equipes clínicas e administrativas sobre documentação adequada e práticas de faturamento.
Orientar a equipe de faturamento sobre as melhores práticas para evitar glosas.
Relatórios e Análises

Sporty Group is a consumer internet and technology business with an unrivalled sports media, gaming, social and fintech platform which serves millions of daily active users across the globe via technology and operations hubs across more than 10 countries and 3 continents.

The recipe for our success is to discover intelligent and energetic people, who are passionate about our products and serving our users, and attract and retain them with a dynamic and flexible work life which empowers them to create value and rewards them generously based upon their contribution.

We are seeking an experienced IT Engineer to take care of our IT needs and provide awesome support to our employees. This is an opportunity to flex your technical muscles daily by gaining exposure to a variety of IT systems, cloud services, and cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced and exciting industry. You will also have the chance to expand your domain knowledge into global IT and security.

Responsibilities

  1. Provide technical assistance, advice, and training to users, resolve issues at the tier one level, and escalate issues to the appropriate escalation team.

  3. Oversee deployment and maintenance of IT systems, ensuring optimal and reliable operations.

  17. Maintain, repair, and upgrade systems and processes, including hardware and software programs.

Skills and Qualification Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Administration, or a closely related field.
  2. 5+ years of relevant experience in IT systems, network administration, and related technologies.
  3. Proficiency with firewalls, SDN, and network routing.
  4. Advanced knowledge of network technology and security principles.
  5. Advanced knowledge of SSO, MDM, and system provisioning in Windows, Mac, and Linux systems.
  6. Advanced knowledge in managing cloud IT services and security.
  7. Understanding and knowledge of the Data Protection Acts.
  8. Articulate complex data law requirements in a clear and user-friendly way/format.
  9. Strong knowledge of systems and networking, and the ability to effectively use computerized solutions.
  10. Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems.
  11. Solid knowledge of best practices in IT administration, system vulnerabilities, and security.
  12. Ability to think critically, analyze root causes, diagnose problems, and provide solutions.
  13. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  14. Ability to work independently and take end-to-end accountability for employee IT issues.
  15. Should be flexible with work from office (Sao Paulo, Brazil).

Benefits

  1. Performance-based quarterly bonus.
  2. Referral bonus.
  3. IT Asset provided.
  4. 28 days paid annual leave.
  5. Annual company retreat.
  6. Highly talented, dependable co-workers in a global, multicultural organization.
  7. Our teams are small enough for you to be impactful.
  8. Our business is globally established and successful, offering stability and security to our Team Members.

Our Mission

Our mission is to be an everyday entertainment platform for everyone.

Our Operating Principles

  1. Create Value for Users.
  2. Act in the Long-Term Interests of Sporty.
  3. Focus on Product Improvements & Innovation.
  4. Be Responsible.
  5. Preserve Integrity & Honesty.
  6. Respect Confidentiality & Privacy.
  7. Ensure Stability, Security & Scalability.
  8. Work Hard with Passion & Pride.

Interview Process

  1. 30 min Aptitude Test.
  2. Remote video screening with our Talent Acquisition Team.
  3. Remote 90 min video interview loop with 3 x Team Members (30 mins each).
  4. 24-72 hour feedback loops throughout the process.

Working at Sporty

The top-down mentality at Sporty is high performance-based, meaning we trust you to do your job with an emphasis on support to help you achieve, grow and de-block any issues when they're in your way. Generally, employees can choose their own hours, as long as they are collaborating and doing stand-ups etc. The emphasis is really on results.

As we are a highly structured and established company, we are able to offer the security and support of a global business with the allure of a startup environment. Sporty is independently managed and financed, meaning we don’t have arbitrary shareholder or VC targets to cater to.

We literally build, spend and make decisions based on the ethos of building THE best platform of its kind. We are truly a tech company to the core and take excellent care of our Team Members.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Senior Analyst – Energy Solutions
About Us:
For the past 12 years,CELA – Clean Energy Latin Americahas been providing financial and strategic advisory services to companies and investors in the renewable energy and energy transition sectors across Latin America.
We are specialists in consultancy (strategic, market, and regulatory), capital raising, project finance, and M&A, in segments such as solar and wind energy, energy storage, and green hydrogen.
For more information, visit:
Position: Senior Analyst – Energy Solutions
Profile:
We are seeking a Senior Analyst/Consultant to work on energy transition projects at CELA.
The candidate must be fluent in English and have prior experience in the power sector, with a background in areas such as self-production, regulation, or market intelligence.
We are looking for a proactive professional, eager to develop in various topics within the energy sector and capable of working independently.
We value professionals who are committed to the energy transition, skilled at building strategic relationships, and who contribute to the success of our dynamic consulting team.
Requirements:
·Minimum of 5 years of experience in the energy sector;
·Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields;
·Proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools;
·Advanced English – capable of leading meetings entirely in English, reading and writing technical materials with ease;
Key Responsibilities:
·Demonstrate technical and regulatory knowledge in self-production, generation, energy trading (with a focus on large consumers), and distributed generation, as well as produce descriptive and analytical reports;
·Assist clients in evaluating their consumption profiles and defining the most suitable energy procurement strategies;
·Support consumers and generators in structuring and negotiating power purchase agreements (PPAs) in the free market, including models such as self-production by equivalence, leasing, consortium, among others;
·Develop studies, reports, and dashboards on energy strategies and contract performance, providing insights for consumers and generators;
·Stay updated on renewable energy market trends, new business models, and regulatory changes;
·Provide support to other areas at CELA with expertise in regulation, energy products, auctions and trading.
Contract:
·Independent contractor ("PJ"), with exclusive dedication to CELA.
Benefits:
·Competitive compensation, negotiable based on the candidate's experience;
·Health and dental plan;
·Paid vacation.
Work Model:
·Primarily remote, with occasional in-person meetings required in São Paulo or other locations.
How to Aplly:
·Please send your CV to Luísa at ****** with the subject line:
"CV – Senior Analyst in Energy Solutions – CELA."

description:
Overview

Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI , GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs


Responsibilities

A oportunidade

Responsável pelo planejamento, gestão e controle das operações comerciais no mercado onde atua, visando atingir as previsões de faturamento nos limites de despesas previstas no orçamento.

Planeja, organiza e gerencia as ações dos distribuidores/clientes sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para alcançar e/ou superar os objetivos estabelecidos pela Cia., respeitando a política comercial e mantendo o crescimento sustentável de sua unidade de negócios. Atua com base nos Valores, Princípios e Código de Conduta.

O seu impacto

Para que você tenha um impacto neste cargo, será necessário:

  • Representar a empresa no desenvolvimento das relações comerciais com os principais clientes e distribuidores da companhia;
  • Atingir periodicamente os objetivos de volume, respeitando as políticas comerciais, e metas internas;
  • Manter a empresa informada sobre as ações de mercado, a fim de alimentar nossas ferramentas gerenciais e indicadores chave de performance;
  • Planejar e gerenciar as atividades do time de Canal complementar, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para alcançar e/ou superar os objetivos de vendas estabelecidos pela Cia.
  • Analisar os indicadores de performance do desempenho dos seus clientes para tomada de decisões;
  • Garantir nossos espaços na área de vendas, nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo a equipe de execução informada sobre as estratégias para o ponto de venda conforme negociação estabelecida para o canal;
  • Realizar gestão de time, desenvolvimento de pessoas, realizar feedbacks, acompanhamento de performance, e rotina;
  • Apoiar e acompanhar negociações e ações do PDV de seus distribuidores (tabloides, aniversário, inaugurações), com o objetivo de maximizar seus resultados;
  • Garantir em seu canal o mix completo da linha de produtos e acompanhar para não haver falta no PDV;
  • Fazer gestão das trocas e controlar descontos promocionais;
  • Fazer gestão de preços (descontos, ST, incentivo fiscal, preço final);
  • Realizar a gestão das cargas e entregas de sell in dos clientes;
  • Realizar junto ao time planejamento de venda por cliente considerando: volume, ações no PDV, aplicação de "Trade Promotion (TP)", controle de desconto médio e verbas de negociação;
  • Acompanhar periodicamente a situação de crédito de seus clientes junto ao departamento de crédito e cobrança;
  • Desenhar estratégias para o canal complementar e cascatear para os vendedores;
  • Gerenciar procedimentos de acompanhamento de notas fiscais de devolução emitidas pelos clientes.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Atuação em Porto Velho - RO
  • Capacidade de trabalhar e liderar equipes;
  • Adaptação ao estilo e abordagem de um ambiente de negócios em constante mudança;
  • Organização e Capacidade Analítica;
  • Conhecimento Pacote Office;
  • Relacionamento.

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos .

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

• Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.

• Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.

• Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.

• Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbrio para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.

• Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.

•Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.

• E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá.

Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá.
Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.

Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá.

Senior Staff BCO - 1st Line Compliance Lead

About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our institutional page

About the Team

As Nubank continues its global expansion and continues innovating, the internal controls landscape becomes increasingly complex. Nubank has developed a strong Risk structure across the 1st and 2nd line of Defense but it is important to continue reinforcing the principles across the company and ensure that our 1st line teams continue to be accountable and responsible for the risks taken.

On that basis, the Business Control Office team is continuing to grow by adding one more area of focus and hiring someone to help us elevate our compliance management within the 1st line of Defense .

About the Role

Regulatory compliance is a complex and a critical component of proper risk management which requires very specific expertise. The initial person joining as the head of 1st line Compliance would help us drive the regulatory agenda in the 1st line with clear accountability and responsibility, and start supporting prioritized teams who are facing regulatory challenges.

It´s an IC position in the beginning with a global scope, with the opportunity to become a manager if the person has the ability to demonstrate how a team could help Nubank become more efficient and compliant with an increased level of support.

Key Responsabilities and Expectations

  • Understanding applicable regulations, and explaining/translating the need to the business according to the BU realities
    • Reading regulations and understanding their implications for the business, making sure requirements are fully mapped through the existing regulatory tracking process
    • Provide assessment to the 1st line through the discovery of regulatory requirements
    • Help the 1LoD to co-create and finalize e2e action plans to be compliant with applicable regulatory requirements, supporting Compliance 2LoD in the monitoring of the implementation of the requirements for new products/features and other regulatory requirements (e.g. 4966)
    • Aligning possible dependencies with other BUs and helping with prioritizations exercise of different bets.
  • Coordinate and support on responses and data shared with regulators (BACEN, CVM, Banxico, SFC, etc) and external/internal auditors on relevant subjects, for both reactive and proactive interactions.
  • Support Compliance on the planning and coordination of inspection when they happen
  • Empowering product teams with the knowledge and tools they need making compliance a competitive advantage of the innovation process making it seamless under a targeted friction approach
  • Performing regulatory assessment proactively for NP&F including the creation and follow up of action plans ahead of Defense assessments
  • Create appropriate timely reports for the leadership team to understand the full spectrum of regulatory risks

What we're looking for:

  • Technical experience: Compliance
  • Ability to challenge the various Lines of Defense
  • Strong ability to prioritise
  • Ability to build strong relationships with all levels of the organization
  • Great communication skills (concise and clear)
  • Hands on and take ownership where possible
  • High level of independence/autonomy
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence when it comes to serving the open source ecosystem. This is your chance to be a part of that as a Community Engineer at Canonical .
We are building community management at scale. We have multiple positions available, at different seniority levels.
All applications and candidates are handled through this single entry point.
The role of a Community Engineer
The Community team at Canonical enables community leaders and participants to get things done, co-ordinating with Canonical teams and ensuring that community processes are efficient and well run. We don't do the work of the community, but we facilitate that work to ensure that energetic and ambitious community members with their own vision of open source can benefit from the work Canonical does and bring their own flavor of Ubuntu into being, to meet the needs and express the interests of their community. You will play a key role in designing, executing, and scaling initiatives that foster a thriving community.
This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient person who is passionate about open source software, Linux, and sustainable community building.
In this role, you will support community initiatives with your technical skills and strong organizational skills. You work hand in hand with developers to smooth processes and integrate community plans with Canonical plans for maximum impact. You can encourage and facilitate the creation of new technical projects that enhance the community contribution experience, and you represent community interests to Canonical teams. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from conception through launch, working closely with Developer Relations engineers, technical authors, product managers, marketing teams, engineering teams, and external partners.
You will support and engage with volunteer developers in the Ubuntu community, addressing their concerns and helping them to create successful tools. You will help to ensure their success and the overall autonomy and sustainability of projects.
You will provide the content and technical support to ensure the community stays engaged and informed. This will include regular blog and social media posts about community initiatives, events, accomplishments, and collaborative efforts between Canonical and the Ubuntu community.
You will communicate effectively with developers and software engineers and represent not only the Ubuntu community but Canonical as a contributor to the wider Linux ecosystem. Our team attends conferences and expos, and talks about technical community projects and their development processes.
Location : These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality content to promote and support community initiatives
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions to community problems
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Potential opportunity to travel more if you wish
  • Nurture community contributions to Ubuntu
  • Engage with the Ubuntu community through Discourse, Matrix, social media, conferences, etc.
  • Represent Ubuntu via speaking engagements at events and conferences
  • Support the engagement by Canonical teams into the open source ecosystem
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have experience with developer tools and open source projects
  • You have a clear public record of accomplishments (talks, blog posts, GitHub, X, etc.)
  • You have interest and experience with some of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, DevOps, software development, testing and QA, package management, container technology
  • You can work autonomously and assume full ownership of objectives as needed
  • You can be flexible with your time and enjoy working with new technology in a fast-paced environment
  • You are experienced working with open source communities and understand the workflow of volunteer contributors
  • You have experience in (technical) program management and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with community management
  • Experience with Developer advocacy
  • Experience as a software developer
  • Examples of contributions to the Ubuntu Community
  • Experience with contributing to open source projects
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
